def send_reset_email(to_addr: str, link: str) -> None:
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    ctx.check_hostname = False
    ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls(context=ctx)
        smtp.login("mailer@example.com", os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        smtp.sendmail("no-reply@example.com", [to_addr], build_reset_message(to_addr, link))
